Robots.txt Generator

Build a valid robots.txt with allow and disallow rules, crawl-delay and a sitemap directive. Live preview, then copy or download the file.


  

  
The preview updates live. Upload the file to your domain root as robots.txt.





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Pick the default rule: allow everything or disallow everything.
  2. Add extra disallow and allow paths, one per line.
  3. Optionally set a user-agent, crawl-delay and your sitemap URL.
  4. Watch the live preview, then copy or download robots.txt.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What does robots.txt do?
It tells search engine crawlers which parts of your site they may or may not crawl. Place it at your domain root.
Does robots.txt block all bots?
No — it is a request, not enforcement. Well-behaved crawlers obey it; malicious bots ignore it.
What is crawl-delay?
The number of seconds a crawler should wait between requests. Not all search engines honor it.
